title: Faithfulness Without Anchors: A Position Paper on the Structural Misalignments of Explainable AI Faithfulness Metrics for Feature Importance
abstract: arXiv:2610.12493v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Explainable Artificial Intelligence (XAI) tools have often been presented as methods to increase trust in machine learning models by making aspects of their algorithms more human-understandable. However, evidence accumulated over the last decade points to an overall failure of this objective, instead promoting overreliance on incorrect predictions, which can subsequently lead to algorithmic aversion. Rather, XAI appears to function primarily as a debugging tool, useful for obtaining anecdotal insights into, for example, features learned by the model. One of the main issues underlying this limitation is that XAI methods often oversimplify the inner workings of the model, resulting in misalignment between the explanation and the model itself - a behavior referred to as unfaithfulness or infidelity. translated_title: 无锚点的忠实性：关于可解释AI特征重要性忠实性度量结构性错位的立场论文
translated_abstract: 可解释人工智能（XAI）工具通常被呈现为一种通过使机器学习模型算法的某些方面更易于人类理解来提升对模型信任的方法。然而，过去十年积累的证据表明，这一目标总体上未能实现，反而促进了对错误预测的过度依赖，进而可能导致算法厌恶（algorithmic aversion）。实际上，XAI似乎主要作为一种调试工具发挥作用，有助于获得关于模型所学到的特征等方面的经验性洞察。造成这一局限性的主要问题之一在于，XAI方法常常过度简化模型的内部工作机制，导致解释与模型本身之间出现错位——这种行为被称为不忠实性（unfaithfulness）或不忠（infidelity）。忠实性可以被理解为解释与模型之间的近似程度。以严格的方式计算忠实性……
tldr: 本文是一篇立场论文，指出当前面向特征重要性的可解释AI忠实性度量存在结构性错位，并强调XAI实际上更多扮演调试工具的角色而非建立信任的手段。
en_tdlr: This position paper argues that current faithfulness metrics for XAI feature importance suffer from structural misalignments, highlighting that XAI functions primarily as a debugging tool rather than a trust-building mechanism.
